embeds.title: 📊 WoW Market Briefing · Nov 22 (update)
embeds.description:
**Verdict**
• Crafting is still thin. The best non-cooldown crafts pay 11-13g but have only **3-4 listings** each.
• Best buys: **Arcane Crystal** (67% of usual price, stock 58%) and **Felcloth** (46% of usual, stock 113%).
• No ladder flips pass the movement gate.
• The market is still falling about **5% a day**. Buy only what you will use soon.
